features.name: Tactical Command
features.text: Trainer Action: choose Aim (Advantage on the active Pokémon’s next attack before your next turn), Guard (+1 Defense and +1 Sp. Defense until your next turn), or Drive (+10 ft movement this turn). You can use Tactical Command a number of times per fight equal to your Trainer Proficiency. Only one Tactical Command can affect a Pokémon at once.

features.name: Battle Instinct
features.text: Once per fight, after your active Pokémon fails an attack roll or Pokémon check, reroll it and use the second result.

features.name: Quick Command
features.text: Once per fight, use Tactical Command as a Trainer Bonus Action instead of a Trainer Action. This still spends one Tactical Command use.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.text: Increase one Trainer ability score by 2, or two Trainer ability scores by 1, to a maximum of 20.

features.name: Veteran Switch
features.text: After a voluntary switch, the incoming Pokémon may immediately move up to 30 ft. The switch still consumes the entire turn and the new Pokémon cannot use a Pokémon Action.

features.name: Pokédex Scan
features.text: Trainer Action: scan one visible Pokémon within 60 ft. Learn species, typing, Defense, Sp. Defense, Capture DC, and current HP band (76–100%, 51–75%, 26–50%, or 1–25%). You can use Pokédex Scan a number of times per fight equal to your Trainer Proficiency.

features.name: Analytical Opening
features.text: After you scan a Pokémon, the first allied attack against it before your next turn has Advantage.

features.name: Rapid Scan
features.text: You may use Pokédex Scan as a Trainer Bonus Action.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.text: Increase one Trainer ability score by 2, or two Trainer ability scores by 1, to a maximum of 20.

features.name: Complete Readout
features.text: A scan also reveals exact current/max HP, all five converted combat stats, current stat stages, active statuses and the target’s four active moves.

features.name: Field Care
features.text: Care Charges = 2 + Trainer Proficiency + Wisdom modifier (minimum 2). Trainer Action: spend 1 charge to restore 1d8 + Wisdom modifier HP to one Pokémon. Charges restore at a Pokémon Center or by replacing supplies at ₽150 per missing charge.

features.name: Condition Care
features.text: Trainer Action: spend 1 Care Charge to remove Burn, Poison, Paralysis or Confusion; spend 2 to remove Sleep or Frozen.

features.name: Emergency Revive
features.text: Trainer Action: spend 2 Care Charges to return a fainted party Pokémon with 1d8 + Wisdom modifier HP.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.text: Increase one Trainer ability score by 2, or two Trainer ability scores by 1, to a maximum of 20.

features.name: Triage
features.text: Once per fight, perform Field Care or Condition Care as a Trainer Bonus Action.

features.name: Wild Rapport
features.text: You have Advantage on checks made to approach, calm, understand or handle wild Pokémon, and you automatically recognise a wild Pokémon’s starting disposition.

features.name: Trailcraft
features.text: Ordinary natural terrain does not significantly slow your group. Once per travel day in suitable terrain, find 1d4 common Berries.

features.name: Capture Setup
features.text: When a wild Pokémon is Friendly or Wary, your Capture Checks against it gain +2.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.text: Increase one Trainer ability score by 2, or two Trainer ability scores by 1, to a maximum of 20.

features.name: Ambush Sense
features.text: While you are conscious, the party cannot normally be surprised by wild Pokémon. You also roll opening Initiative with Advantage against wild encounters.

features.name: Encourage
features.text: Trainer Action: choose Attack, Sp. Attack or Speed. Your active Pokémon gains +1 stage in that stat. Only one stage granted by Encourage may exist at a time. You can use Encourage a number of times per fight equal to your Trainer Proficiency.

features.name: Pokémon Bond
features.text: Your active Pokémon has Advantage on noncombat Pokémon checks while it can see or hear you.

features.name: Rhythm
features.text: If your Pokémon uses a different move from the move it used on its previous turn, it gains +1 to that move’s attack roll. This does not affect moves without attack rolls.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.text: Increase one Trainer ability score by 2, or two Trainer ability scores by 1, to a maximum of 20.

features.name: Baton Spirit
features.text: When you voluntarily switch Pokémon, the incoming Pokémon may inherit one positive stat stage, maximum +1, from the outgoing Pokémon.

features.name: Field Fabrication
features.text: With your toolkit and a safe workspace, craft Common consumable items for 50% of their listed shop price. A normal batch takes about 30 minutes.

features.name: Ball Tuning
features.text: Immediately before a Capture Check, use a Trainer Bonus Action to give that Poké Ball +1 to the check. You can use Ball Tuning a number of times per fight equal to your Trainer Proficiency.

features.name: TM Specialist
features.text: When you use a consumable TM, roll 1d6. On 5–6, the move is taught normally and the TM is not consumed.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.text: Increase one Trainer ability score by 2, or two Trainer ability score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

features.name: Advanced Fabrication
features.text: Craft Uncommon items for 60% of shop price. Ball Tuning improves to +2.
